papers.title: Near Minimax Rate for Quantile Distributional Reinforcement Learning
papers.translated_title: 分位数分布式强化学习的近极小极大速率
papers.author: Zijie Cheng
papers.summary: In this paper, we study quantile distributional policy evaluation, where the return distribution under a given policy is approximated by the quantile Bellman fixed point $\bmη_m$. We investigate the statistical accuracy of estimating $\bmη_m$ across quantile resolutions under Wasserstein distances. Assuming access to a generative model, we construct a quantile fixed point estimator $\bmη_m^{(n)}$ from an empirical Markov decision process and establish non-asymptotic error bounds under Wasserstein distances. When reward densities are uniformly bounded away from zero, we obtain a root-$n$ high-probability bound simultaneously over all resolutions $m$ and all Wasserstein orders $1\le p\le\infty$. When reward densities vanish at the support endpoints, we show that continuity and endpoint monotonicity suffice to preserve the same resolution-independent rate for $1\le p\le2$. For $p>2$, we establish a root-$n$ bound with coefficient $m^{1/2-1/p}$, together with a slower, resolution-independent $n^{-1/p}$ bound for every finite $p>2$. We further obtain resolution-independent $W_\infty$ consistency governed by the continuity modulus of reward quantile functions. To investigate the sharpness of these bounds, we characterize the exact local asymptotic minimax risk at each fixed resolution as the expected Wasserstein-coordinate norm of the efficient Gaussian limit and prove that our estimator attains it. We then examine the resolution dependence of this optimal local risk. A regular one-state instance has resolution-independent local risk constants, whereas a single endpoint-vanishing two-state instance exhibits growth of order $m^{1/2-1/p}$, up to logarithmic factors along a resolution subsequence, for every $p>2$.
papers.translated_summary: 本文研究分位数分布策略评估，其中给定策略下的回报分布由分位数贝尔曼不动点 $\bmη_m$ 近似。我们研究在 Wasserstein 距离下跨分位数分辨率估计 $\bmη_m$ 的统计精度。假设可以访问生成模型，我们从经验马尔可夫决策过程构造分位数不动点估计量 $\bmη_m^{(n)}$，并在 Wasserstein 距离下建立非渐近误差界。当奖励密度一致有界远离零时，我们得到一个根号 $n$ 的高概率界，该界同时对所有分辨率 $m$ 和所有 Wasserstein 阶 $1\le p\le\infty$ 成立。当奖励密度在支撑端点处消失时，我们证明连续性和端点单调性足以在 $1\le p\le2$ 时保持相同的分辨率无关速率。对于 $p>2$，我们建立一个系数为 $m^{1/2-1/p}$ 的根号 $n$ 界，并对每个有限 $p>2$ 建立一个较慢的、分辨率无关的 $n^{-1/p}$ 界。我们进一步得到由奖励分位数函数的连续性模控制的、分辨率无关的 $W_\infty$ 一致性。为了研究这些界的锐性，我们将每个固定分辨率下的精确局部渐近极小极大风险刻画为有效高斯极限的期望 Wasserstein 坐标范数，并证明我们的估计量达到该风险。然后我们研究该最优局部风险对分辨率的依赖性。一个规则的单状态实例具有分辨率无关的局部风险常数，而一个单端点消失的两状态实例对每个 $p>2$ 表现出阶为 $m^{1/2-1/p}$ 的增长，沿分辨率子序列可达对数因子。

papers.title: A Transfer Learning-Driven Methodology for Efficient and Sustainable Indoor Localization Using VLC
papers.translated_title: 一种用于高效可持续室内定位的迁移学习驱动方法（基于可见光通信）
papers.author: Masood Jan
papers.summary: The rapid expansion of the Internet of Things enables seamless collaboration among connected devices, making indoor localization a critical component of industrial automation. However, conventional localization techniques struggle in dynamic environments. These methods depend on extensive, frequent data collection and environment-specific calibration, limiting scalability, interoperability, and effective use of prior research while imposing significant energy penalties that hinder practical deployment. To address these challenges, we propose an energy-efficient transfer learning (TL) based approach for visible light communication based indoor localization. Our method leverages TL to tackle environmental variability, including lighting fluctuations and physical obstacles that typically degrade localization performance, while simultaneously reducing computational overhead and energy consumption compared to conventional approaches. We also introduce a novel model efficiency (ME) metric, designed to integrate localization accuracy, energy efficiency, data efficiency, and transfer gain into a single evaluative measure for comprehensive optimization. Evaluations on a real-world dataset collected from a BOSCH factory demonstrate that our model achieves a 47% improvement in localization accuracy compared to a conventional model that does not utilize TL, and achieves up to 67.5% ME with TL models, compared to only 10.4% in conventional models under high-noise conditions. These results underscore the potential of our approach to deliver a highly efficient and scalable indoor localization system suitable for energy-constrained industrial applications.
papers.translated_summary: 物联网的快速扩展实现了连接设备之间的无缝协作，使室内定位成为工业自动化的关键组成部分。然而，传统定位技术在动态环境中面临困难。这些方法依赖于大量、频繁的数据采集和针对特定环境的校准，限制了可扩展性、互操作性以及对已有研究的有效利用，同时带来显著的能耗代价，阻碍了实际部署。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种基于能量高效迁移学习（TL）的可见光通信室内定位方法。我们的方法利用迁移学习来应对环境变化，包括通常会使定位性能下降的光照波动和物理障碍，同时相比传统方法降低计算开销和能耗。我们还引入了一种新的模型效率（ME）度量，旨在将定位精度、能量效率、数据效率和迁移增益整合为单一评估指标，以实现全面优化。在从BOSCH工厂采集的真实数据集上的评估表明，与未使用迁移学习的传统模型相比，我们的模型在定位精度上提升了47%，并且在高噪声条件下，迁移学习模型实现了高达67.5%的ME，而传统模型仅为10.4%。这些结果凸显了我们的方法在提供适用于能量受限工业应用的高效且可扩展的室内定位系统方面的潜力。

papers.title: CineEvolve: An Agentic Self-Evolution Framework for Cinematic Multi-Shot Video Generation
papers.translated_title: CineEvolve：一种用于电影级多镜头视频生成的智能体自进化框架
papers.author: Jingzhe Zhang
papers.summary: Cinematic multi-shot video generation requires both narrative planning and iterative refinement. Existing methods either lack narrative reasoning or rely on feed-forward workflows without policy updates. In this paper, we propose CineEvolve, an agentic self-evolution framework for cinematic multi-shot video generation that unifies a Director and a Critic within a single vision-language policy. Emulating real-world filmmaking that couples iterative direction with critical feedback, we train CineEvolve via alternating reinforcement learning, where the Director surfaces flaws to sharpen the Critic, and the updated Critic guides the Director's targeted revisions. To stabilize co-evolution, we introduce Evolutionary GRPO (E-GRPO), leveraging historical anchoring and revision safeguarding to mitigate advantage inflation. Additionally, we contribute CineTraj, a 40K cinematic trajectory dataset spanning creation, critique, and revision. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CineEvolve outperforms existing approaches. Our code will be available at https://github.com/JingZhe-8/CineEvolve.
papers.translated_summary: 电影级多镜头视频生成既需要叙事规划，也需要迭代优化。现有方法要么缺乏叙事推理，要么依赖无策略更新的前馈工作流。本文提出CineEvolve，一种用于电影级多镜头视频生成的智能体自演化框架，将导演与评论家统一在单一视觉语言策略中。模拟真实电影制作中将迭代指导与批判性反馈相结合的过程，我们通过交替强化学习训练CineEvolve，其中导演揭示缺陷以强化评论家，更新后的评论家指导导演进行针对性修改。为稳定协同演化，我们引入Evolutionary GRPO（E-GRPO），利用历史锚定和修订保护来缓解优势膨胀。此外，我们贡献了CineTraj，一个涵盖创作、评论和修订的40K电影轨迹数据集。大量实验表明CineEvolve优于现有方法。我们的代码将在https://github.com/JingZhe-8/CineEvolve提供。

papers.title: Fragment-Level Graph Encoding for Interpretable Molecular Property Prediction
papers.translated_title: 片段级图编码用于可解释的分子性质预测
papers.author: Rafael Lopes Almeida
papers.summary: Graph neural networks (GNNs) are among the standard tools for molecular property prediction, but the atom-level explanations of their predictions are hard for medicinal chemists to act on. We propose a change of input representation rather than a new model: molecules are encoded as fragment-level graphs from BRICS decomposition, where each node is a synthetically meaningful fragment whose features are the element-wise sum of its atoms' features. Because only the representation changes, any message-passing GNN and any post-hoc attribution method produces explanations at the resolution of functional groups instead of single atoms. Across four architectures, four prediction tasks, and two explainers under scaffold splits, fragment-level encoding matches atom-level test accuracy on roughly five-fold smaller graphs. Integrated-Gradients attributions recover known pharmacophores above chance on two enzyme targets, namely BACE at 1.5 times the chance rate, and PTR1 at 3.2 times. A like-for-like comparison against an aggregated atom-level baseline shows that post-hoc aggregation is not a stable substitute: its BACE hit rate range both exceeds and falls below the fragment model's hit rate depending on two arbitrary aggregation choices, whereas fragment-level training yields a single convention-free attribution at no predictive cost. The code is available at: https://github.com/4D-Lab/frame
papers.translated_summary: 图神经网络（GNN）是分子性质预测的标准工具之一，但其预测结果在原子层面的解释难以为药物化学家所采用。我们提出改变输入表示而非构建新模型：分子通过 BRICS 分解编码为片段级图，其中每个节点是一个具有合成意义的片段，其特征为其所含原子特征的逐元素求和。由于仅表示发生变化，任何消息传递 GNN 和任何事后归因方法都会在官能团而非单个原子的分辨率上产生解释。在四种架构、四项预测任务和两种解释器于骨架拆分下的实验中，片段级编码在约五分之一大小的图上达到了与原子级编码相当的测试准确率。积分梯度归因在两个酶靶标上以高于随机水平的比例恢复了已知药效团，即 BACE 达到随机比例的 1.5 倍，PTR1 达到 3.2 倍。与聚合原子级基线进行的同类比较表明，事后聚合并非稳定的替代方案：其 BACE 命中率范围根据两种任意的聚合选择既超过又低于片段模型的命中率，而片段级训练在无预测代价的情况下产生了单一的无约定归因。代码可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/4D-Lab/frame

papers.title: SatCraft: Agentic Optimization of Scheduling Policies for Satellite-Cellular Edge Services
papers.translated_title: SatCraft：面向卫星-蜂窝边缘服务的调度策略智能体优化
papers.author: Pengcheng Luo
papers.summary: Mobile edge services can combine local computation with satellite and cellular access to deliver time-sensitive results in areas with intermittent terrestrial coverage. Meeting their deadlines and quality requirements calls for joint computation and transmission scheduling that accounts for task dependencies, changing link capacity, and shared resource budgets. However, optimizing resource allocations or tuning parameters within a fixed policy structure offers limited scope to correct failures rooted in the scheduling logic. We propose SatCraft, a framework in which a large language model (LLM) agent uses execution feedback to revise the code of joint scheduling policies. Each revision undergoes policy checks and complete-run evaluation to assess its validity, runtime, and effects on service completion. Because policy performance varies with access conditions, SatCraft retains valid alternatives in a policy library and selects one for each episode using initial access observations and the known resource configuration. Experiments using Starlink and cellular measurement data show that SatCraft improves cumulative completed-service value by 3.61%-16.89% over baselines, including recent state-of-the-art scheduling methods ADPRL, EdgeOPT, and TF-DDRL. It achieves the highest completed-service value in all four resource profiles and averages 25.02 ms per scheduling call. These results demonstrate how LLM-guided policy optimization can improve complete service delivery under the computing, communication, and quality constraints of satellite-cellular networks.
papers.translated_summary: 移动边缘服务可以将本地计算与卫星及蜂窝接入相结合，在陆地覆盖间歇性区域提供时间敏感的结果。满足其截止时间和质量要求，需要联合计算与传输调度，并考虑任务依赖关系、链路容量变化以及共享资源预算。然而，在固定策略结构内优化资源分配或调整参数，对于纠正根源于调度逻辑的失败所能提供的空间有限。我们提出SatCraft，一个框架，其中大型语言模型（LLM）智能体利用执行反馈来修改联合调度策略的代码。每次修改都经过策略检查和完整运行评估，以评估其有效性、运行时间以及对服务完成的影响。由于策略性能随接入条件变化，SatCraft将有效的备选策略保留在策略库中，并利用初始接入观测和已知资源配置为每个回合选择一个策略。使用Starlink和蜂窝测量数据的实验表明，SatCraft相比基线将累计完成服务价值提高了3.61%-16.89%，基线包括近期最先进的调度方法ADPRL、EdgeOPT和TF-DDRL。它在所有四种资源配置中均实现了最高的完成服务价值，平均每次调度调用耗时25.02毫秒。这些结果展示了LLM引导的策略优化如何在卫星-蜂窝网络的计算、通信和质量约束下改善完整的服务交付。

papers.title: Unlocking Spatial Grounding in Flow-Matching Models via SNR Tuning
papers.translated_title: 通过SNR调优解锁流匹配模型中的空间定位
papers.author: Martin Thißen
papers.summary: Despite the success of foundation models in image synthesis, achieving fine-grained spatial control remains a significant challenge, typically requiring auxiliary structural adapters or complex inference-time steering. While modern vision-language (VLM) text encoders possess the latent capacity to represent spatial coordinates, generative models often fail to leverage this information. We demonstrate that the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) distribution is a critical determinant of spatial grounding in flow-matching models. Using a novel synthetic benchmark of geometric primitives, we isolate structural mechanics from textural complexity inherent in natural imagery and introduce a rigorous color-aware layout metric to quantify spatial fidelity. We show that training on a centered SNR distribution results in poor layout adherence (25.9%). Instead, we identify high-noise regimes as a "critical learning phase" for spatial grounding. Shifting the training focus toward these stages increases layout adherence to 80.8%, effectively reaching the 83.6% reconstruction ceiling of the underlying variational autoencoder. We find that the necessity for this shift scales with resolution and aspect ratio variance, and that the conservative noise schedules employed by models like FLUX.1 are insufficient for precise layout adherence. Finally, we show that these findings translate to real-world imagery via the COCO dataset (1.0 vs. 57.3 Average Precision), where state-of-the-art layout adherence is unlocked through distribution tuning alone, without architectural modifications.
papers.translated_summary: 尽管基础模型在图像合成方面取得了成功，实现细粒度的空间控制仍然是一项重大挑战，通常需要辅助结构适配器或复杂的推理时引导。虽然现代视觉语言（VLM）文本编码器具备表示空间坐标的潜在能力，但生成模型往往未能利用这一信息。我们证明，信噪比（SNR）分布是流匹配模型中空间定位的关键决定因素。使用一个新颖的几何基元合成基准，我们将结构机制从自然图像固有的纹理复杂性中分离出来，并引入一个严格的颜色感知布局度量来量化空间保真度。我们表明，在中心化SNR分布上训练会导致较差的布局遵循度（25.9%）。相反，我们将高噪声区间确定为空间定位的“关键学习阶段”。将训练重点转向这些阶段可将布局遵循度提升至80.8%，有效达到底层变分自编码器83.6%的重建上限。我们发现，这种转变的必要性随分辨率和宽高比方差而增加，并且像FLUX.1这样的模型所采用的保守噪声调度不足以实现精确的布局遵循。最后，我们表明这些发现通过COCO数据集可迁移至真实世界图像（1.0 vs. 57.3 平均精度），其中仅通过分布调优即可解锁最先进的布局遵循度，而无需架构修改。

papers.title: Fast Bayesian Optimization Through Linear Models
papers.translated_title: 通过线性模型实现快速贝叶斯优化
papers.author: Colin Doumont
papers.summary: Bayesian optimization (BO) is typically used only for problems where the underlying function is deemed "expensive" (e.g. in time or money), with the speed of the BO algorithm being of little importance. In the real world, however, problems span a continuous range of values, going from cheap to expensive. In this paper, we present BO algorithms through the lens of a speed-performance Pareto frontier: we compare BO against faster algorithms like CMA-ES, and highlight how certain regions of the Pareto frontier are currently empty. As a solution, we propose a new set of fast BO methods that exploit the linear structure in existing BO algorithms, for both continuous and combinatorial inputs (from ~10 to 6000+ dimensions). Our methods achieve performance similar to state-of-the-art BO, while being more than $10^2\times$ to $10^3\times$ faster, opening the field of BO to an entirely new class of problems.
papers.translated_summary: 贝叶斯优化（BO）通常仅用于底层函数被认为“昂贵”的问题（例如在时间或金钱上），而BO算法的速度则不太重要。然而在现实世界中，问题跨越从廉价到昂贵的连续取值区间。本文从速度-性能帕累托前沿的视角呈现BO算法：我们将BO与CMA-ES等更快的算法进行比较，并指出帕累托前沿的某些区域目前仍是空白的。作为解决方案，我们提出了一组新的快速BO方法，利用现有BO算法中的线性结构，适用于连续和组合输入（从约10维到6000维以上）。我们的方法达到了与最先进BO相似的性能，同时速度快$10^2\times$到$10^3\times$以上，为BO领域开辟了一类全新的问题。

papers.title: What Prediction-Market Contracts Reveal at Launch: Trading Volume and Dispute Risk
papers.translated_title: 预测市场合约推出时揭示了什么：交易量与争议风险
papers.author: Ahmed Mahrous
papers.summary: Using a near-census of 802,863 resolved markets listed on Polymarket between January 2023 and May 2026, and only information available at listing (the market's title and description, named resolution source, and contract metadata), we predict lifetime trading volume and whether settlement is later disputed. Contract information predicts trading volume well (out-of-sample $R^2 = 0.747$ for log volume), and most of the signal is interpretable: market topic provides the largest gain ($+0.289$ $R^2$ over a $0.220$ contract-feature baseline), wording and resolution-rule design add smaller but measurable improvements ($+0.027$ combined), and neural text models add little beyond the interpretable features. This performance does not survive a period of platform change coinciding with a shift in listing formats: accuracy in predicting whether a market reaches \$1,000 falls from AUC $0.940$ under same-period evaluation to $0.577$ when training on past quarters and testing on later ones. The loss concentrates in markets whose question forms were absent from training (76.9% of test markets; on familiar forms the model still reaches $0.778$), and a decomposition attributes more of it to a changed relationship between contract characteristics and demand than to an outdated mapping from text to features. Dispute predictors are more stable but less precise: launch-time features rank dispute risk far better than chance (AUC $0.78$), yet at a 0.31% base rate precision is too low for case-by-case prediction (average precision $0.012$), so the scores suit ranking groups of markets rather than forecasting individual disputes.
papers.translated_summary: 利用2023年1月至2026年5月期间Polymarket上列出的802,863个已结算市场的近全量普查数据，并仅使用上市时可获得的信息（市场标题与描述、指定结算来源以及合约元数据），我们预测市场的生命周期交易量以及结算是否会在后续产生争议。合约信息对交易量具有良好的预测能力（对数交易量的样本外R² = 0.747），且大部分信号具有可解释性：市场主题带来最大增益（在0.220的合约特征基线之上提升R² +0.289），措辞与结算规则设计带来较小但可测量的改进（合计+0.027），而神经文本模型在可解释特征之外几乎没有额外贡献。这一表现未能经受住平台变更期的考验，该时期恰逢上市格式的转变：预测市场是否达到1,000美元时，同期评估下AUC为0.940，而用过去季度训练并测试后续季度时降至0.577。性能损失集中于问题形式在训练中未出现的市场（占测试市场的76.9%；在熟悉形式上模型仍达到0.778），分解分析将更多损失归因于合约特征与需求之间关系的变化，而非文本到特征映射的过时。争议预测器更稳定但精度较低：上市时特征对争议风险的排序远优于随机（AUC 0.78），但在0.31%的基础率下，精度过低，无法进行个案预测（平均精度0.012），因此这些评分适合对市场群体进行排序，而非预测个体争议。

papers.title: The Reflexivity Threshold: A Phase Transition for Multi-Agent Performative Prediction
papers.translated_title: 反身性阈值：多智能体表演性预测的相变
papers.author: Ahmed Mahrous
papers.summary: Many learning systems are performative: once deployed, their predictions change the data distribution on which future models are trained. In multi-agent settings, this feedback is routed through a network of interacting learners, so stability depends not only on the strength of performativity but also on who affects whom. We study repeated retraining in multi-agent performative prediction and identify a spectral threshold that separates stable learning from worst-case learning obstruction. Prior work often collapses cross-agent feedback into a scalar contraction constant, missing this network structure. We instead introduce the reflexivity matrix $Γ$, which records how strongly one agent's deployment can move another agent's best response, defined from per-agent gradient sensitivities and curvature parameters. The threshold occurs when the spectral radius of this matrix crosses one. Below the threshold, repeated retraining converges geometrically to a unique performatively stable equilibrium, with cumulative excess loss bounded uniformly in the time horizon. Above the threshold, we construct noisy supercritical instances in which every local-information learner incurs expected cumulative excess loss growing linearly for horizons up to order $1/(ρ(Γ)-1)$. Together, these results characterize the threshold behavior through upper and lower bounds and recover the single-agent scalar threshold from prior work as a special case.
papers.translated_summary: 许多学习系统具有表演性：一旦部署，其预测就会改变未来模型训练所依据的数据分布。在多智能体环境中，这种反馈通过一个相互交互的学习者网络进行路由，因此稳定性不仅取决于表演性的强度，还取决于谁影响谁。我们研究多智能体表演性预测中的重复再训练，并识别出一个谱阈值，它将稳定学习与最坏情况下的学习障碍区分开来。先前的工作通常将跨智能体反馈简化为一个标量收缩常数，忽略了这种网络结构。我们转而引入反射矩阵 $Γ$，它记录了一个智能体的部署能在多大程度上推动另一个智能体的最佳响应，该矩阵由每个智能体的梯度敏感性和曲率参数定义。当该矩阵的谱半径越过一时，阈值出现。在阈值以下，重复再训练几何收敛到唯一的表演性稳定均衡，累积超额损失在时间范围上一致有界。在阈值以上，我们构造了噪声超临界实例，其中每个局部信息学习者在高达 $1/(ρ(Γ)-1)$ 量级的时间范围上，其期望累积超额损失线性增长。这些结果共同通过上界和下界刻画了阈值行为，并将先前工作中的单智能体标量阈值作为特例恢复出来。

papers.title: Private Online Prediction from Experts with Small Losses
papers.translated_title: 小损失下基于专家的私密在线预测
papers.author: Bo Li
papers.summary: We consider online prediction from experts, a fundamental problem in machine learning, under differential privacy constraints. Existing private algorithms achieve near-optimal regret $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$, where $T$ is the time horizon. However, this bound becomes suboptimal when $L^\star$, the cumulative loss of the best expert, is significantly less than $T$. In this work, we present the first differentially private algorithm with regret $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{L^\star})$, offering a substantial improvement in the low-loss regime. Our regret bound matches the non-private lower bound up to poly-logarithmic factors for constant privacy parameters, demonstrating that privacy incurs only a small cost in this setting. Our result assumes that the input sequence is oblivious, i.e., it is fixed in advance and independent of the algorithm's outputs. We also prove that an $\tildeΩ(\sqrt{T})$ regret is inevitable for adaptively generated inputs, even when $L^\star = 0$.
papers.translated_summary: 我们研究在差分隐私约束下基于专家的在线预测，这是机器学习中的一个基本问题。现有的隐私算法达到了接近最优的遗憾界 $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$，其中 $T$ 是时间跨度。然而，当 $L^\star$（最佳专家的累积损失）显著小于 $T$ 时，该界变得次优。在本工作中，我们提出了第一个具有 $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{L^\star})$ 遗憾界的差分隐私算法，在低损失情形下提供了显著改进。对于常数隐私参数，我们的遗憾界在忽略多对数因子的意义下与非隐私下界相匹配，表明在此设定下隐私仅带来很小的代价。我们的结果假设输入序列是 oblivious 的，即它提前固定且独立于算法的输出。我们还证明了对于自适应生成的输入，即使 $L^\star = 0$，$\tilde{\Omega}(\sqrt{T})$ 的遗憾界也是不可避免的。

papers.title: A physical theory of organismal metabolism across life
papers.translated_title: 跨生命有机体代谢的物理理论
papers.author: Pelz, P. F.
papers.summary: A fundamental but unanswered biological question is how much energy life forms expend per unit mass and time to remain alive (Makarieva et al., 2008). The West-Brown-Enquist (WBE) theory explains Kleiber's 3/4-power law (Kleiber, 1932) through complex vascular networks (West et al., 1997; Banavar et al., 1999; West et al., 1999; Dodds et al., 2001; Gillooly et al., 2001; West et al., 2002; Banavar et al., 2002; Kozowski & Konarzewski, 2004; Brown et al., 2005; White et al., 2007; Savage et al., 2008; Apol et al., 2008), but assumes "size-invariant terminal units" and predicts neither absolute rates, small-organism linearity, nor group-specific levels. Yet capillary dimensions vary with body mass (Dawson, 2003) and obey Murray's optimization principle (Murray, 1926). Furthermore, 3/4-power scaling occurs in planarians with a simple tubular metabolic system (Thommen et al., 2019). Here we extend Krogh's capillary--tissue unit (Krogh, 1919) to an optimized mesoscale oxygen-transport system, the Metabolic Holon (MH). Krogh's geometry, Murray's minimum-work principle, and optimal oxygen utilization determine its geometry and operating state. Kleiber's asymptote thus emerges from an optimized Krogh unit, without requiring complex vascular-network architecture; repetition and within-group body-mass-invariant topology determine organismal metabolism. Without fitting metabolic-rate data, MH predicts absolute rates across 18 orders of magnitude (R^2 = 97.7 %), including linear scaling and group-specific Kleiber asymptotes. Independent dimensional analysis recovers these asymptotes. The theory also predicts absolute mammalian heart rates without calibration; absolute lifespan additionally requires an empirical lifetime-heartbeat constraint. By representing evolutionary selection and adaptation through mesoscale optimization, the theory explains why "mass-specific metabolic rates are strikingly similar across life's major domains" (Makarieva et al., 2008).
papers.translated_summary: 一个根本但尚未解答的生物学问题是，生命形式为维持生存每单位质量和时间消耗多少能量（Makarieva et al., 2008）。West-Brown-Enquist（WBE）理论通过复杂的血管网络解释Kleiber的3/4幂律（Kleiber, 1932）（West et al., 1997; Banavar et al., 1999; West et al., 1999; Dodds et al., 2001; Gillooly et al., 2001; West et al., 2002; Banavar et al., 2002; Kozowski & Konarzewski, 2004; Brown et al., 2005; White et al., 2007; Savage et al., 2008; Apol et al., 2008），但假设“尺寸不变的终端单元”，既不预测绝对速率，也不预测小生物体的线性关系，也不预测类群特异性水平。然而毛细血管尺寸随体重变化（Dawson, 2003）并遵循Murray的最优化原理（Murray, 1926）。此外，3/4幂标度出现在具有简单管状代谢系统的涡虫中（Thommen et al., 2019）。在此，我们将Krogh的毛细血管-组织单元（Krogh, 1919）扩展为一个优化的中尺度氧运输系统，即代谢全元（Metabolic Holon, MH）。Krogh的几何结构、Murray的最小功原理和最优氧利用决定了其几何结构和运行状态。因此，Kleiber渐近线从一个优化的Krogh单元中涌现，而无需复杂的血管网络架构；重复和组内体重不变的拓扑结构决定了生物体代谢。在不拟合代谢速率数据的情况下，MH预测了跨越18个数量级的绝对速率（R^2 = 97.7 %），包括线性标度和类群特异性Kleiber渐近线。独立的量纲分析恢复了这些渐近线。该理论还无需校准即可预测哺乳动物的绝对心率；绝对寿命额外需要一个经验性的终生心跳约束。通过中尺度最优化来表征进化选择和适应，该理论解释了为什么“跨生命主要领域的质量特异性代谢率惊人地相似”（Makarieva et al., 2008）。

papers.title: Peak performance is repeatable and captures large individual differences in ruby-throated hummingbirds
papers.translated_title: 巅峰表现具有可重复性，并在红喉蜂鸟中体现出较大的个体差异
papers.author: Gagnon, E. C.
papers.summary: Locomotor performance often determines the outcome of interactions with competitors, predators, and prey. In flying animals, the asymptotic load-lifting assay measures maximal muscle power output in vertical flight. Previous studies of small birds have shown that load-lifting performance is linked to flight maneuverability and the outcome of competitive species interactions. Here, we quantify sources of performance variation within a species, namely repeatability, and determine the number of trials that accurately capture individual differences. We conducted 124 load-lifting trials on 13 wild-caught male ruby-throated hummingbirds (Archilochus colubris), testing each individual repeatedly over a 3-day period. We report large individual differences in peak performance, with 70% of the total variation in lifted mass attributed to differences among males. Notably, these differences in muscle performance are independent of body mass and size. An additional 23% of the variation in lifted mass was due to short-term fluctuations, wherein a given male's performance varied across trials and days. We find no systematic effects of experience or time on load-lifting performance. Using simulation, we test the effect of different sampling protocols for measuring individual performance, and show that single-trial protocols yield the highest repeatabilities, but are less suitable for capturing the true underlying differences among individuals. We discuss recommendations for future studies that aim to measure maximum performance. Overall, our results show that the asymptotic load-lifting assay reveals large individual differences and can closely reflect individuals' true maximum capacity.
papers.translated_summary: 运动表现往往决定与竞争者、捕食者和猎物互动的结果。在飞行动物中，渐近负载提升测定法测量垂直飞行中的最大肌肉功率输出。此前对小型鸟类的研究表明，负载提升表现与飞行机动性以及竞争性物种互动的结果相关。在此，我们量化了一个物种内表现变异的来源，即可重复性，并确定了能准确捕捉个体差异的试验次数。我们对13只野生捕获的雄性红喉蜂鸟（Archilochus colubris）进行了124次负载提升试验，在3天时间内对每个个体重复测试。我们报告了峰值表现上的巨大个体差异，提升质量总变异的70%归因于雄性之间的差异。值得注意的是，这些肌肉表现差异与体重和体型无关。提升质量变异的另外23%归因于短期波动，即某一雄性个体的表现在不同试验和不同天数之间存在变化。我们未发现经验或时间对负载提升表现的系统性影响。通过模拟，我们检验了不同采样方案对测量个体表现的影响，并表明单次试验方案产生最高的可重复性，但较不适合捕捉个体之间的真实潜在差异。我们讨论了旨在测量最大表现的未来研究的建议。总体而言，我们的结果表明，渐近负载提升测定法揭示了巨大的个体差异，并能密切反映个体的真实最大能力。

papers.title: Discrete synaptic states and context-modulated readouts support continual learning
papers.translated_title: 离散突触状态与情境调制读出支持持续学习
papers.author: Gao, Y.
papers.summary: Biological neural systems learn new behaviors while retaining earlier ones, whereas sequentially trained artificial networks often overwrite parameters and forget previously learned behaviors. We introduce the Context-modulated Synaptic-states Recurrent Neural Network (CoSyn-RNN), a new continual-learning model inspired by heterogeneous synaptic states and neuromodulatory control. CoSyn-RNN combines sparse recurrent allocation with a discrete protection rule: after each task, recurrent neurons whose synaptic weights cross a fixed threshold form a task-specific neuron group, and their associated parameters enter a protected state during later learning. A neuron-specific gain and a task-cued mask over a fixed base readout control how recurrent activity contributes to behavior. Across various task sequences consisting of many cognitive tasks, training and validation losses and accuracies were maintained throughout learning. The protection rule produced modular, task-ordered recurrent structure compatible with forward reuse of earlier computations. Pairwise recruitment measurements further defined minimum- and maximum-cost curricula that produced markedly different final recurrent structures and different remaining capacity for future learning. Thus, CoSyn-RNN provides a biologically inspired model in which protected synaptic states, sparse allocation, and context-dependent modulation support continual learning.
papers.translated_summary: 生物神经网络在学习新行为的同时保留先前学到的行为，而顺序训练的人工网络往往会覆盖参数并遗忘先前学到的行为。我们提出了情境调制突触状态循环神经网络（CoSyn-RNN），这是一种受异质性突触状态和神经调质控制启发的新型持续学习模型。CoSyn-RNN 将稀疏循环分配与离散保护规则相结合：在每个任务之后，突触权重越过固定阈值的循环神经元形成一个任务特异性神经元群，其相关参数在后续学习中进入保护状态。神经元特异性增益和固定基础读出上的任务线索掩码控制循环活动如何贡献于行为。在由许多认知任务组成的各种任务序列中，训练和验证损失及准确率在整个学习过程中得以保持。保护规则产生了模块化、按任务排序的循环结构，与先前计算的向前重用相兼容。成对募集测量进一步定义了最小成本和最大成本课程，这些课程产生了显著不同的最终循环结构以及未来学习的不同剩余容量。因此，CoSyn-RNN 提供了一个受生物启发的模型，其中受保护的突触状态、稀疏分配和情境依赖调制支持持续学习。

papers.title: Cortical Selectivity to Real-World Object Size In Natural Images
papers.translated_title: 自然图像中大脑皮层对真实世界物体大小的选择性
papers.author: Hlayhel, A.
papers.summary: Real-world size is a fundamental property of objects that supports adaptive interactions with the physical environment. Prior fMRI studies have identified large-scale organization in higher visual cortex associated with real-world object size but have relied primarily on decontextualized objects presented on simple backgrounds. Here, we ask whether this neural organization generalizes to objects embedded within the context of complex natural scene images. To address this question, we used voxelwise analyses and encoding models to assess neural responses to natural images from two independent fMRI datasets. These analyses identified reliable organization encompassing alternating regions of sensitivity for small and large objects across the ventral and lateral surfaces of occipitotemporal cortex, which largely aligns with prior findings using isolated objects. At the same time, we identify additional, previously unreported size-related organization on the ventral surface at a finer spatial scale. We also find real-world size sensitivity for both animate and inanimate objects, with broadly corresponding cortical patterns across the two domains. Importantly, controlling for low- and mid-level visual features, object composition, and scene clutter attenuated the magnitude of size sensitivity in some regions, but closely preserved the spatial organization and directionality of neural size preferences. Finally, we characterized the shape of voxelwise tuning functions for real-world object size, and found that a logarithmic-like relationship predominated, although profile shape varied across regions and between small- and large-preferring voxels. Overall, our findings support real-world object size as a behaviorally-relevant dimension of cortical organization during natural vision.
papers.translated_summary: 真实世界大小是物体的基本属性，支持与物理环境的适应性交互。先前fMRI研究已识别出高级视觉皮层中与真实世界物体大小相关的大尺度组织，但主要依赖于在简单背景上呈现的去情境化物体。在此，我们探讨这种神经组织是否能推广到嵌入复杂自然场景图像情境中的物体。为解决这一问题，我们使用逐体素分析和编码模型，评估来自两个独立fMRI数据集对自然图像的神经反应。这些分析识别出可靠的组织，涵盖枕颞皮层腹侧和外侧表面上小物体与大物体敏感性的交替区域，这在很大程度上与先前使用孤立物体的发现一致。同时，我们在腹侧表面更精细的空间尺度上识别出额外的、此前未报道的大小相关组织。我们还发现对有生命和无生命物体的真实世界大小敏感性，两个领域具有大致对应的皮层模式。重要的是，控制低层和中层视觉特征、物体组成和场景杂乱度减弱了某些区域的大小敏感性幅度，但密切保留了神经大小偏好的空间组织和方向性。最后，我们表征了逐体素真实世界物体大小调谐函数的形状，发现对数式关系占主导，尽管轮廓形状因区域以及偏好小物体和偏好大物体的体素而异。总体而言，我们的发现支持真实世界物体大小作为自然视觉过程中皮层组织的行为相关维度。

papers.title: The limbic navigation system as a hierarchical RNN
papers.translated_title: 边缘系统导航系统作为一种分层RNN
papers.author: Ji, Z.
papers.summary: Path-integration-trained recurrent neural networks (RNNs) can reproduce grid-like and head-direction-like representations, but most existing models rely on low-dimensional velocity inputs and do not capture the hierarchical organisation of the brain's self-localisation circuit. We introduce a hierarchical recurrent neural network (HRNN) that separately processes angular velocity and linear speed to perform simultaneous angular and positional path integration. Trained on these tasks, the HRNN generalises to longer timescales than seen during training and develops neural response properties resembling all the key cell types: angular velocity cells, head direction cells, speed cells, conjunctive and pure grid cells. The learned circuit also recovers key motifs of the navigation system, including attractor dynamics and asymmetric connectivity patterns. Perturbation analyses reveal functional information flow across the hierarchy, consistent with experimental observations. Finally, introducing theta-paced mutual inhibition between two learned angular-velocity subpopulations enables the HRNN to reproduce the bidirectional theta sweeps observed in empirical data. These results establish hierarchical task-driven RNNs as a biologically interpretable framework for linking neural representations, circuit motifs, and population dynamics in spatial navigation, while enabling targeted in silico perturbations and the generation of experimentally testable predictions.
papers.translated_summary: 路径积分训练循环神经网络（RNN）能够重现类网格细胞和类头方向细胞的表征，但大多数现有模型依赖低维速度输入，未能捕捉大脑自我定位回路的分层组织。我们提出一种分层循环神经网络（HRNN），分别处理角速度和线速度，以同时执行角度和位置的路径积分。在这些任务上训练后，HRNN能够泛化到比训练时更长的时间尺度，并发展出类似所有关键细胞类型的神经响应特性：角速度细胞、头方向细胞、速度细胞、联合网格细胞和纯网格细胞。学习到的回路还恢复了导航系统的关键基序，包括吸引子动力学和非对称连接模式。扰动分析揭示了跨层次的功能信息流，与实验观察一致。最后，在两个学习到的角速度子群体之间引入θ节律的相互抑制，使HRNN能够重现经验数据中观察到的双向θ扫掠。这些结果确立了分层任务驱动RNN作为一个生物学可解释的框架，用于连接空间导航中的神经表征、回路基序和群体动力学，同时支持有针对性的计算机扰动和生成可实验检验的预测。

papers.title: Opposing reward-epoch population coding in anterior insular cortex dissociates sign- and goal-tracking despite equivalent conditioned responding
papers.translated_title: 前岛叶皮层中相反的奖赏-时期群体编码在条件反应相当的情况下分离了符号追踪和目标追踪
papers.author: Keefer, S. E.
papers.summary: When Pavlovian lever cues predict reward, rats diverge in how they express learned associations: sign-tracking (ST) rats approach and engage the cue with greater persistence, while goal-tracking (GT) rats approach the reward site and are more consistently outcome-sensitive. The anterior insular cortex (aIC) and its interactions with amygdala and striatal regions are differentially recruited across phenotypes, implicating aIC as a node where associative strategy diverges at the circuit level. To characterize this neural divergence independent of differences in conditioned responding, we recorded single-unit aIC activity in ST and GT rats performing an odor-guided sucrose discrimination task with equivalent approach behavior. At the population level, GT aIC was dominated by task-excited neurons that drove sucrose discrimination, while ST aIC carried a greater proportion of task-inhibited neurons whose suppression carried the dominant discrimination signal, a dissociation specific to the reward epoch. During cue sampling, the balance of excited and inhibited neurons did not differ between phenotypes, but temporal structure diverged: ST cue-excited neurons showed transient CS-onset responses without sustained discrimination, while GT cue-excited neurons maintained sustained CS+/CS- discrimination into the reward epoch. ST cue-period firing predicted post-cue approach latency, with stronger responses associated with slower goal approach, a relationship absent in GT. The majority of optogenetically identified aIC projection neurons targeting basolateral amygdala and nucleus accumbens were cue-inhibited. These findings reveal that individual differences in associative strategy are encoded in the organizational structure of aIC population activity, positioning aIC as a site where motivational strategy is translated into distinct outputs.
papers.translated_summary: 当巴甫洛夫杠杆线索预测奖赏时，大鼠在表达习得关联的方式上出现分化：线索追踪（ST）大鼠接近并参与线索，且表现出更强的持续性，而目标追踪（GT）大鼠接近奖赏位置，并更一致地对结果敏感。前岛叶皮层（aIC）及其与杏仁核和纹状体区域的相互作用在不同表型间被差异性募集，提示aIC是关联策略在环路层面发生分化的节点。为了在不受条件反应差异影响的情况下表征这种神经分化，我们记录了ST和GT大鼠在具有等效接近行为的嗅觉引导蔗糖辨别任务中的aIC单单元活动。在群体水平上，GT的aIC由驱动蔗糖辨别的任务兴奋性神经元主导，而ST的aIC携带更高比例的任务抑制性神经元，其抑制携带主要辨别信号，这是一种特异于奖赏时段的分离。在线索采样期间，兴奋性和抑制性神经元的平衡在不同表型间没有差异，但时间结构出现分化：ST线索兴奋性神经元表现出短暂的CS起始反应，而没有持续辨别，而GT线索兴奋性神经元将持续的CS+/CS-辨别维持到奖赏时段。ST线索期放电预测线索后接近潜伏期，反应越强与目标接近越慢相关，这种关系在GT中不存在。光遗传学鉴定的靶向基底外侧杏仁核和伏隔核的aIC投射神经元大多数为线索抑制性。这些发现揭示，关联策略的个体差异编码在aIC群体活动的组织结构中，将aIC定位为动机策略被转化为不同输出的位点。

papers.title: Serotonergic Control of Spine Morphology During Growth in Zebrafish
papers.translated_title: 斑马鱼生长过程中血清素能对树突棘形态的调控
papers.author: Schauer, S. R.
papers.summary: Scoliosis is a three-dimensional deformity of the vertebral column that commonly emerges during growth, yet the biological mechanisms that initiate and drive curve progression remain poorly understood. Serotonin (5-hydroxytryptamine [5-HT]) has long been linked to scoliosis through its relationship with pineal melatonin signaling and through genetic associations with human disease, but its role in spinal morphogenesis has remained unclear. Here, using zebrafish, we show that serotonergic signaling is required for normal spine morphology. Transient exposure to 5-HT during development induces later spinal abnormalities, while loss of Tph2, an enzyme required for neuronal 5-HT synthesis, causes progressive three-dimensional spinal curvature during juvenile growth. tph2 mutants nevertheless exhibit initially normal vertebral patterning, arguing against an early skeletal defect as the initiating cause of curvature. Additionally, sustained ablation of exorh-positive pineal photoreceptors does not induce spinal curvature, arguing against a pineal origin for the phenotype. The Reissner fiber, which has also been linked to spinal curvature in zebrafish, formed normally in tph2 mutants. Instead, mutants showed a marked reduction in Fev-expressing intraspinal serotonergic neurons together with increased locomotor activity, characterized by longer swim bouts and shorter periods of inactivity between bouts. Importantly, these neuronal and motor defects were evident before the onset of overt spinal curvature. Together, these findings identify neuronal serotonin as a critical regulator of spinal stability and support a model in which altered serotonergic control of motor function changes the mechanical environment experienced by the growing spine, increasing its susceptibility to progressive curvature.
papers.translated_summary: 脊柱侧弯是脊柱的三维畸形，通常在生长发育过程中出现，但引发并驱动弯曲进展的生物学机制仍知之甚少。5-羟色胺（5-hydroxytryptamine [5-HT]）长期以来通过其与松果体褪黑素信号的关系以及与人类疾病的遗传关联而被认为与脊柱侧弯有关，但其在脊柱形态发生中的作用仍不清楚。在此，我们利用斑马鱼表明，5-羟色胺能信号是正常脊柱形态所必需的。在发育过程中短暂暴露于5-HT会诱导后期脊柱异常，而Tph2（神经元5-HT合成所需的酶）的缺失会导致幼体生长过程中出现进行性三维脊柱弯曲。然而，tph2突变体最初表现出正常的椎骨模式，这反对早期骨骼缺陷是弯曲起始原因的观点。此外，持续消融exorh阳性松果体光感受器不会诱导脊柱弯曲，这反对该表型源于松果体的观点。Reissner纤维（也与斑马鱼脊柱弯曲有关）在tph2突变体中正常形成。相反，突变体表现出表达Fev的脊髓内5-羟色胺能神经元显著减少，同时运动活性增加，其特征是游泳持续时间更长、两次游泳之间的不活动期更短。重要的是，这些神经元和运动缺陷在明显的脊柱弯曲出现之前就已显现。总之，这些发现确定神经元5-羟色胺是脊柱稳定性的关键调节因子，并支持这样一种模型：5-羟色胺能对运动功能的控制发生改变，从而改变生长中的脊柱所经历的力学环境，增加其发生进行性弯曲的易感性。

papers.title: Habituation drives elevated antimicrobial resistance, functional, and compositional shifts in the black bear gut microbiome
papers.translated_title: 习惯化驱动黑熊肠道微生物组中抗菌素耐药性、功能及组成的升高与转变
papers.author: Vance, S. E.
papers.summary: Wildlife habituation across the globe poses threats to human and animal safety and alters regular ecological function, yet the wildlife, environmental, and public health ramifications are poorly characterized. The gut microbiome is a valuable proxy for these factors as it influences host health, is affected by anthropogenic exposure, and may contribute to the environmental spread of virulence factors. Despite their importance, wildlife gut microbiomes are largely uncharacterized, both in composition and function. We characterized American black bear (Ursus americanus) gut microbiomes across a spectrum of lifestyles including wild (conflict-free), habituated (conflict-prone), and captive individuals. 16S rRNA gene sequencing was used for compositional analyses and whole genome short-read sequencing (WGS) was performed on a subset of bears to investigate microbiome function and virulence factors. We found that habituated, wild, and captive bears have unique gut microbiome compositions that are indicative of their respective lifestyles. In particular, captive bears are enriched in carnivory-associated taxa and habituated bears in inflammatory taxa. WGS reveals wild bears have increased fungi and soil-associated bacteria, as well as higher proportions of unclassified reads. Habituated bears have significantly increased levels of antimicrobial resistance genes, and captive bears are enriched in enterotoxins. Our results demonstrate previously undescribed wildlife physiological and One Health consequences of habituation.
papers.translated_summary: 全球范围内的野生动物习惯化对人类和动物安全构成威胁，并改变正常的生态功能，然而野生动物、环境和公共卫生方面的后果却鲜有表征。肠道微生物组是这些因素的有价值替代指标，因为它影响宿主健康，受人为暴露的影响，并可能促进毒力因子的环境传播。尽管其重要性，野生动物肠道微生物组在组成和功能上很大程度上尚未被表征。我们对美洲黑熊（Ursus americanus）在不同生活方式谱系中的肠道微生物组进行了表征，包括野生（无冲突）、习惯化（易冲突）和圈养个体。使用16S rRNA基因测序进行组成分析，并对一部分熊进行了全基因组短读长测序（WGS），以研究微生物组功能和毒力因子。我们发现习惯化、野生和圈养熊具有独特的肠道微生物组组成，这些组成指示了它们各自的生活方式。特别是，圈养熊富集了与食肉相关的分类群，习惯化熊富集了炎症相关分类群。WGS揭示野生熊具有增加的真菌和土壤相关细菌，以及更高比例的未分类读数。习惯化熊的抗菌素耐药基因水平显著增加，圈养熊富集了肠毒素。我们的结果展示了先前未描述的野生动物习惯化的生理和One Health后果。

papers.title: Leveraging the joint site frequency spectrum to detect genomic regions of early divergence
papers.translated_title: 利用联合位点频率谱检测早期分化的基因组区域
papers.author: Calderon, A.
papers.summary: Detecting genomic loci underlying local adaptation is a central goal in population genetics. Such loci have been discovered using a variety of approaches, but the statistical performance of these approaches can depend substantially on the frequencies of the alleles underlying phenotypic adaptation. In particular, multiple evolutionary modeling studies have shown that rare alleles of large effect can make substantial contributions to phenotypic variance and potentially adaptive divergence, but most selection inference methods are not sensitive to rare alleles. We used simulations of evolutionary divergence to compare commonly-used FST scans to a likelihood-based approach that interrogates the whole frequency spectrum. We found that the likelihood-based approach outperforms FST in simulations in which low frequency alleles play a substantial role in driving trait divergence. We applied both approaches to genomic data from Ostrinia nubilalis (the European Corn Borer), a species in which population-specific variation in circannual rhythms and mate preference phenotypes have driven recent reproductive isolation. The likelihood-based approach recovers previously discovered genomic loci and finds several new candidate regions that may be relevant for reproductive isolation between populations. Our findings demonstrate how the two-dimensional frequency spectrum may help to identify loci contributing to reproductive isolation in contexts when commonly used methods are less powerful.
papers.translated_summary: 检测局部适应背后的基因组位点是群体遗传学的核心目标。此类位点已通过多种方法被发现，但这些方法的统计性能可能在很大程度上取决于表型适应所 underlying 等位基因的频率。特别是，多项进化建模研究表明，效应较大的稀有等位基因可对表型方差和潜在的适应性分化做出实质性贡献，但大多数选择推断方法对稀有等位基因不敏感。我们利用进化分化的模拟，将常用的FST扫描与一种 interrogates 整个频率谱的基于似然的方法进行了比较。我们发现，在低频等位基因在驱动性状分化中起重要作用的模拟中，基于似然的方法优于FST。我们将这两种方法应用于Ostrinia nubilalis（欧洲玉米螟）的基因组数据，该物种中 circannual 节律和交配偏好表型的种群特异性变异驱动了近期的生殖隔离。基于似然的方法恢复了先前发现的基因组位点，并发现了几个可能与种群间生殖隔离相关的新候选区域。我们的研究结果表明，在常用方法效力较低的情境下，二维频率谱如何有助于识别促成生殖隔离的位点。

papers.title: Incorporating host traits into analysis of parasite life history reveals facilitation in coinfection experiments.
papers.translated_title: 将宿主特征纳入寄生虫生活史分析揭示了共感染实验中的促进作用。
papers.author: Gupta, V.
papers.summary: Coinfection, when hosts are infected with more than one parasite, can modify life-history traits of both parasites and their host. We investigated reciprocal interactions between tomato spotted wilt virus (TSWV) and a non-vector spider mite, Tetranychus urticae, in coinfections on tomato plants. We compared the number of T. urticae daughters and adults and the viral load for two TSWV isolates (France81, which is more virulent, and LYE1137vir) in single and coinfections, and measured host traits (height, fresh weight, chlorophyll content, and number of flowers). TSWV infection reduced plant height, weight, flowers and chlorophyll content, especially when infected with isolate France81. T. urticae only reduced plant height. The more virulent TSWV isolate facilitated spider mites by increasing the number of daughters per unit of plant height, thus potentially enabling equivalent levels of mite transmission as from virus-free plants. In contrast, there was no effect of T. urticae on the load of either TSWV isolate. Nevertheless, the additive reduction in plant height in coinfection may increase host mortality and reduce the time available for transmission of both parasites. This work highlights that it can be important to incorporate measures of host and parasite life-history traits across an entire infection when investigating the consequences of coinfection for parasite fitness.
papers.translated_summary: 共感染，即宿主同时感染多种寄生虫，可以改变寄生虫及其宿主的生活史特征。我们研究了番茄斑萎病毒（TSWV）与非传播媒介二斑叶螨（Tetranychus urticae）在番茄植株共感染中的相互作用。我们比较了单感染和共感染条件下二斑叶螨雌性后代数和成螨数以及两种TSWV分离株（France81，毒力较强，和LYE1137vir）的病毒载量，并测定了宿主性状（株高、鲜重、叶绿素含量和花数）。TSWV感染降低了植株株高、重量、花数和叶绿素含量，尤其是感染France81分离株时。二斑叶螨仅降低植株株高。毒力较强的TSWV分离株通过增加单位株高上的雌性后代数来促进叶螨，从而可能使螨的传播水平与无病毒植株相当。相比之下，二斑叶螨对两种TSWV分离株的载量均无影响。然而，共感染中株高的叠加降低可能增加宿主死亡率并缩短两种寄生虫的传播可用时间。这项工作强调，在研究共感染对寄生虫适合度的影响时，纳入整个感染过程中宿主和寄生虫生活史特征的测量可能具有重要意义。

papers.title: Lactiplantibacillus plantarum PD01 supplementation reduces microplastics and microplastic-associated chemicals in humans: A randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial.
papers.translated_title: 植物乳杆菌PD01补充剂可减少人体内的微塑料及微塑料相关化学物质：一项随机、双盲、安慰剂对照试验。
papers.author: Lu, R.
papers.summary: BACKGROUND Plastic products improve daily convenience but release pollutants that threaten human health, and effective elimination strategies remain limited. METHODS In a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial, we assessed whether Lactiplantibacillus plantarum PD01, previously isolated from a donor with high-microplastic (MP) excretion, accelerates MP elimination. Of 106 participants recruited, 96 were randomized to placebo or PD01. Fecal MPs and urinary phthalate metabolites were measured by pyrolysis-gas chromatography-mass spectrometry and liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry at baseline, week 3, and week 6. Primary outcomes were changes in MP concentrations and phthalate metabolite levels, analyzed with linear mixed-effects models. RESULTS PD01 significantly increased fecal excretion of polycarbonate (PC) and total MPs at week 3 (PC: estimated mean difference, 3.19; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.98 to 5.40; interaction P =0.005; total MPs: 1.99; 95% CI, 0.78 to 3.21; interaction P =0.001) and week 6 (PC: 2.87; 95% CI, 0.66 to 5.08; interaction P =0.011; total MPs: 1.25; 95% CI, 0.04 to 2.47; interaction P =0.044). By week 6, urinary phthalate metabolites were significantly lower with PD01 than placebo (MnBP: -0.96; 95% CI, -1.73 to -0.18; interaction P =0.016; MEHHP: -0.91; 95% CI, -1.79 to -0.02; interaction P =0.046; MECPP: -1.06; 95% CI, -2.09 to -0.03; interaction P =0.045; {Sigma}DEHP: -0.97; 95% CI, -1.84 to -0.09; interaction P =0.031). CONCLUSIONS This trial provides a feasible, low-cost, gut-targeted strategy to accelerate pollutant clearance and represents the first clinical evidence that human plastic burden can be lowered without dietary or behavioral restrictions. (ClinicalTrials.gov: NCT07416214.)
papers.translated_summary: 背景 塑料制品提升了日常便利性，但会释放威胁人类健康的污染物，而有效的清除策略仍然有限。方法 在一项随机、双盲、安慰剂对照试验中，我们评估了此前从一名高微塑料（MP）排泄供体分离的植物乳植杆菌PD01是否能加速MP清除。在招募的106名参与者中，96人被随机分配至安慰剂组或PD01组。在基线、第3周和第6周，通过热裂解-气相色谱-质谱法和液相色谱-质谱法测定粪便MP和尿液邻苯二甲酸酯代谢物。主要结局为MP浓度和邻苯二甲酸酯代谢物水平的变化，采用线性混合效应模型分析。结果 PD01在第3周显著增加聚碳酸酯（PC）和总MP的粪便排泄（PC：估计平均差3.19；95%置信区间[CI] 0.98至5.40；交互作用P=0.005；总MP：1.99；95% CI 0.78至3.21；交互作用P=0.001）和第6周（PC：2.87；95% CI 0.66至5.08；交互作用P=0.011；总MP：1.25；95% CI 0.04至2.47；交互作用P=0.044）。至第6周，PD01组尿液邻苯二甲酸酯代谢物显著低于安慰剂组（MnBP：-0.96；95% CI -1.73至-0.18；交互作用P=0.016；MEHHP：-0.91；95% CI -1.79至-0.02；交互作用P=0.046；MECPP：-1.06；95% CI -2.09至-0.03；交互作用P=0.045；{Sigma}DEHP：-0.97；95% CI -1.84至-0.09；交互作用P=0.031）。结论 本试验提供了一种可行、低成本、靶向肠道的策略以加速污染物清除，并首次提供了临床证据，表明无需饮食或行为限制即可降低人体塑料负荷。（ClinicalTrials.gov：NCT07416214。）

papers.title: Product mix and time since cessation among Korean former smokers using non-combusted nicotine products: a KNHANES analysis with implications for lung cancer risk comparisons
papers.translated_title: 韩国前吸烟者使用非燃烧型尼古丁产品的产品组合及戒烟时长：一项KNHANES分析及其对肺癌风险比较的启示
papers.author: Cook, S. F.
papers.summary: Introduction: A Korean National Health Insurance Service (NHIS) cohort study reported higher lung cancer incidence among former smokers who used e-cigarettes after quitting than among those who quit without them. Interpreting that association requires knowing which product was used and how long ago participants quit; the cohort measured neither directly, but the contemporaneous Korea National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (KNHANES) did. Methods: KNHANES 2018, a cross-sectional national survey, used the NHIS umbrella e-cigarette term, a separate heated tobacco product (HTP) item, and months since cessation. Former smokers using either product (n = 43) were compared with those using neither (n = 1,305), with replication in 2019-2023. Results: Of adults affirming current umbrella e-cigarette use, 64% also reported HTP use (former smokers, 50%); 79% of product-using former smokers reported HTP use. Median time since cessation was eight months among product users and twelve years among others (Kolmogorov-Smirnov D = 0.76, P < 0.001). The gap was replicated in every wave through 2023 (D = 0.63-0.76) and persisted in the long-term quitter stratum (pooled 2019-2023 medians, 6 vs 18 years), in Kim et al.'s high-risk subgroup (2 vs 12 years), after age matching (residual 9.0-11.0 years) and among umbrella-item respondents only (D = 0.73). Conclusions: The reported association is consistent with residual confounding by cessation timing and with product misclassification. It also rests on few exposed events: 16 in the long-term stratum, and 31 of 71 retained when exposure was updated at the next screening. Because at most half of the exposure was exclusive liquid e-cigarette use, an e-cigarette-specific estimate would need about four times as many exposed events for the same precision. Repeated-screening designs that update cessation and product use at every screening, already used for cessation in the same database, would retain the full sample and allow more precise, product-specific dose-response estimates.
papers.translated_summary: 引言：一项韩国国民健康保险服务（NHIS）队列研究报告称，戒烟后使用电子烟的既往吸烟者，其肺癌发病率高于未使用电子烟而戒烟的既往吸烟者。解读这一关联需要了解使用的是哪种产品以及参与者戒烟多久；该队列研究并未直接测量这两项，但同期的韩国国民健康与营养调查（KNHANES）进行了测量。方法：KNHANES 2018是一项横断面全国调查，使用了NHIS的电子烟统称术语、单独的加热烟草制品（HTP）条目以及戒烟月数。使用任一产品的既往吸烟者（n = 43）与两者均不使用者（n = 1,305）进行比较，并在2019-2023年进行重复验证。结果：在确认当前使用统称电子烟的成年人中，64%同时报告使用HTP（既往吸烟者中为50%）；使用产品的既往吸烟者中有79%报告使用HTP。使用产品者戒烟时间中位数为八个月，其他人为十二年（Kolmogorov-Smirnov D = 0.76，P < 0.001）。这一差距在截至2023年的每一轮调查中均得到重复验证（D = 0.63-0.76），并在长期戒烟者分层中持续存在（2019-2023年合并中位数，6年 vs 18年），在Kim等人的高风险亚组中（2年 vs 12年），在年龄匹配后（残差9.0-11.0年）以及在仅统称条目应答者中（D = 0.73）均持续存在。结论：所报告的关联与戒烟时间的残余混杂和产品错误分类相一致。该关联还依赖于很少的暴露事件：长期分层中为16例，当在下次筛查时更新暴露情况时，71例中保留了31例。由于最多只有一半的暴露为独家使用液体电子烟，要获得相同精度的电子烟特异性估计，需要约四倍的暴露事件。重复筛查设计在每次筛查时更新戒烟情况和产品使用情况，已在同一数据库中用于戒烟研究，将保留完整样本并允许更精确的、产品特异性的剂量-反应估计。

papers.title: Privacy-Preserving Large Language Model Deployment for Oncology Registry Abstraction: Structure-Aware Evaluation in a Real-World Clinical Setting
papers.translated_title: 面向肿瘤登记信息提取的隐私保护大语言模型部署：真实临床环境中的结构感知评估
papers.author: Moldovan, M.
papers.summary: Objectives Structuring oncology clinical notes into registry-grade variables is essential for research and care but remains labour-intensive and error-prone. This study developed and evaluated a privacy-preserving large language model pipeline for oncology registry abstraction in a real-world clinical setting. Methods An open-source Meta Llama 3.3 70B-based pipeline, prompted without task-specific fine-tuning, was deployed to extract over 50 variables from 6,700 oncology notes at a cancer centre in Singapore. Data were de-identified locally using a Hide-In-Plain-Sight approach, ensuring no identifiable data left hospital infrastructure. Performance was assessed on 200 randomly sampled notes with adjudicated ground truth, using a structure-aware framework that classified outputs as correct, missing, spurious, or incorrect. Results F1 scores were high across variables, including diagnosis (97.2%), histology (95.8%), stage (92.6%), biomarkers (91.4%), and treatments (88.1%). Preliminary transferability testing on 50 external notes showed strong performance for core diagnostic variables, with reduced performance for list-valued variables. Discussion The structure-aware evaluation approach separated omissions from fabrications, providing more clinically actionable insight than aggregate metrics alone. Conclusion Privacy-preserving large language models achieved high extraction accuracy under a clinician-verified reference standard, supporting their feasibility for oncology registry abstraction in real-world clinical settings. Keywords: Large language models; Oncology registry abstraction; Natural language processing; Privacy-preserving AI; Clinical data extraction What is already known on this topic Structuring oncology clinical notes into registry-grade variables is essential for cancer research and care but remains labour-intensive, costly, and inconsistent from one reviewer to the next when performed manually. Large language models offer potential to automate this task, but their use in real-world registries has been limited by concerns over patient data privacy, reliance on task-specific fine-tuning, and evaluation methods that obscure the difference between missing and fabricated information. What this study adds This study shows that an open-source, privacy-preserving large language model pipeline, deployed entirely within hospital infrastructure without task-specific fine-tuning, can extract over 50 registry variables from oncology notes with high accuracy (F1 scores 88-97% across key variables), validated against ground truth checked by two clinicians. Using a structure-aware evaluation framework, we demonstrate that errors can be meaningfully separated into missing, spurious, and incorrect categories, offering clearer insight into model behaviour than aggregate accuracy metrics alone, and show preliminary evidence of transferability to notes from an external setting. How this study might affect research, practice or policy These findings support the feasibility of deploying privacy-preserving, locally hosted large language models for oncology registry abstraction without requiring identifiable data to leave hospital systems or extensive model customisation. The structure-aware evaluation framework is also shared as a reusable template, enabling other institutions to validate similar AI extraction tools in a consistent, clinically meaningful way before wider implementation.
papers.translated_summary: 目标 将肿瘤学临床记录结构化为登记级变量对于研究和诊疗至关重要，但目前仍劳动密集且容易出错。本研究开发并评估了一种隐私保护的大语言模型流水线，用于在真实临床环境中进行肿瘤学登记数据提取。方法 在新加坡一家癌症中心部署了一个基于开源Meta Llama 3.3 70B的流水线，无需任务特定微调即可提示，从6，700份肿瘤学记录中提取50多个变量。数据在本地使用Hide-In-Plain-Sight方法进行去标识化，确保没有可识别数据离开医院基础设施。在200份随机抽样的记录上评估性能，以经裁定的真实标签为参考，采用结构感知框架将输出分类为正确、缺失、虚假或错误。结果 各变量的F1分数较高，包括诊断（97.2%）、组织学（95.8%）、分期（92.6%）、生物标志物（91.4%）和治疗（88.1%）。在50份外部记录上的初步可迁移性测试显示，核心诊断变量表现良好，但列表值变量表现下降。讨论 结构感知评估方法将遗漏与捏造区分开来，比仅使用聚合指标提供更具临床可操作性的洞察。结论 隐私保护大语言模型在经临床医生验证的参考标准下实现了高提取准确率，支持其在真实临床环境中用于肿瘤学登记数据提取的可行性。关键词：大语言模型；肿瘤学登记数据提取；自然语言处理；隐私保护AI；临床数据提取 关于本主题的已知信息 将肿瘤学临床记录结构化为登记级变量对于癌症研究和诊疗至关重要，但手动执行时仍然劳动密集、成本高昂，且不同审阅者之间不一致。大语言模型有潜力实现该任务自动化，但其在真实世界登记中的应用受到患者数据隐私担忧、对任务特定微调的依赖，以及掩盖缺失信息与捏造信息差异的评估方法的限制。本研究新增的内容 本研究表明，一个开源、隐私保护的大语言模型流水线完全部署在医院基础设施内，无需任务特定微调，即可从肿瘤学记录中高准确率地提取50多个登记变量（关键变量的F1分数为88-97%），并经过两名临床医生核查的真实标签验证。使用结构感知评估框架，我们证明错误可以有意义地分为缺失、虚假和错误类别，比仅使用聚合准确率指标更清晰地洞察模型行为，并展示了对外部环境记录可迁移性的初步证据。本研究可能对研究、实践或政策的影响 这些发现支持部署隐私保护、本地托管的大语言模型用于肿瘤学登记数据提取的可行性，无需可识别数据离开医院系统或进行大量模型定制。结构感知评估框架还作为可复用模板共享，使其他机构能够在更广泛实施前以一致、具有临床意义的方式验证类似的AI提取工具。

papers.title: Left Ventricular Diastolic Intraventricular Pressure Differences and Propagation Velocity with 4D-Flow MRI in Patients with Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy
papers.translated_title: 肥厚型心肌病患者左心室舒张期室内压力差与传播速度的4D血流磁共振成像研究
papers.author: Stipechi, L. V.
papers.summary: Background: Transthoracic echocardiography (TTE) remains the gold standard for assessing left ventricular (LV) diastolic dysfunction (DD), but noninvasive alternatives are needed to overcome geometric and acoustic limitations. 4D-Flow MRI enables comprehensive assessment of intraventricular pressure differences (IVPDs) and flow propagation velocity (VP). We aimed to evaluate 4D-Flow-derived IVPDs and VP in patients with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM). Methods: Thirty-eight HCM patients and 38 age- and sex-matched healthy controls underwent TTE and 4D-Flow MRI. Spatiotemporal maps of velocity and IVPDs, decomposed into inertial and convective components, were derived along the main inflow streamline from the mitral valve to the apex. Peak early filling rate (PEFR) was used to normalize IVPDs and VP. Results: While absolute peak flow rates were comparable, HCM patients exhibited significantly faster VP (100.4 vs. 60.2 cm/s, p < 0.01) and higher positive early E IVPD (1.40 vs. 0.92 mmHg, p < 0.01) compared to controls. Normalizing IVPDs by PEFR amplified group differences, revealing a markedly increased flow-normalized E-IVPD (5.13 vs. 2.94 x 103 mmHg.ml1.s, p < 0.001) and deeper reverse ER IVPD (-6.06 vs. -4.61 x 103 mmHg.ml1.s, p < 0.01) in HCM. These differences were primarily driven by the inertial components. Multivariable analysis demonstrated that ER IVPD is independently determined by PEFR and the TTE E/E' ratio (r = 0.65, p < 0.001). Conclusions: 4D-Flow MRI-derived, flow-normalized IVPDs and propagation velocity provide robust, noninvasive markers of altered LV chamber stiffness and impaired diastolic filling in HCM, offering deeper 3D hemodynamic insights into diastolic dysfunction.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：经胸超声心动图（TTE）仍是评估左心室（LV）舒张功能障碍（DD）的金标准，但需要无创替代方法来克服几何学和声学限制。4D-Flow MRI能够全面评估心室内压力差（IVPDs）和血流传播速度（VP）。本研究旨在评估肥厚型心肌病（HCM）患者中4D-Flow衍生的IVPDs和VP。方法：38例HCM患者和38例年龄、性别匹配的健康对照者接受了TTE和4D-Flow MRI检查。沿从二尖瓣到心尖的主要流入流线，推导出速度和IVPDs的时空图，并将其分解为惯性分量和对流分量。采用峰值早期充盈率（PEFR）对IVPDs和VP进行归一化。结果：虽然绝对峰值流量相当，但与对照组相比，HCM患者表现出显著更快的VP（100.4 vs. 60.2 cm/s，p < 0.01）和更高的正向早期E IVPD（1.40 vs. 0.92 mmHg，p < 0.01）。通过PEFR对IVPDs进行归一化放大了组间差异，揭示HCM中血流归一化E-IVPD显著增加（5.13 vs. 2.94 x 103 mmHg.ml1.s，p < 0.001）以及更深的反向ER IVPD（-6.06 vs. -4.61 x 103 mmHg.ml1.s，p < 0.01）。这些差异主要由惯性分量驱动。多变量分析表明，ER IVPD由PEFR和TTE E/E'比值独立决定（r = 0.65，p < 0.001）。结论：4D-Flow MRI衍生的、血流归一化的IVPDs和传播速度提供了稳健的无创标志物，可反映HCM中左心室腔僵硬度改变和舒张充盈受损，为舒张功能障碍提供了更深入的三维血流动力学见解。

papers.title: Natural Language Processing Based Solution for Labeling Brain Metastasis Identified in Radiology Reports
papers.translated_title: 基于自然语言处理的放射学报告中识别出的脑转移瘤标注解决方案
papers.author: Liu, T.
papers.summary: Abstract Purpose: Brain metastases (BM) far exceed primary CNS tumours and constitute the majority workload for neuro-oncology care providers. Currently, the cancer registries only capture synchronous BMs, which is only a small proportion of all BMs. We aim to develop and validate a natural language processing (NLP) algorithm that identifies brain metastases in radiology reports, enabling scalable surveillance of asynchronous BMs. Methods: Using population-based cancer registry data in Alberta, Canada, we identified a cancer cohort diagnosed between 2012--2019 with follow-up to 2022. All brain/head radiology reports at and post-cancer diagnosis were identified. Reports were sampled through a multi-phase approach and manually labeled for BM presence. We trained two Bio_ClinicalBERT models on the "Findings" and "Impressions" sections, respectively, and took the maximum predicted probability as the report-level prediction. Internal and external validation used reports from the Canadian provinces of Alberta, Ontario, and British Columbia. Results: The models were trained on 1,879 samples. For internal validation, 1,833 reports from 357 patients were tested. At a probability threshold of 0.4, the model achieved a sensitivity of 0.888 and precision of 0.499. The ensemble substantially outperformed single-section models, which achieved sensitivities of only 0.678 (Findings) and 0.742 (Impressions). On external validation, sensitivity was 0.837 in Ontario and 0.726 in British Columbia, demonstrating robustness across diverse data sources. Conclusions: An NLP-based pipeline processing both Findings and Impressions sections has been developed and validated in three Canadian provinces. It meets cancer registry operational requirements and to be implemented into the surveillance workflow in Alberta and British Columbia, providing a foundation for population-level BM surveillance. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/valerie-lth/BM-NLP.
papers.translated_summary: 摘要 目的：脑转移瘤（BM）的数量远超原发性中枢神经系统肿瘤，构成了神经肿瘤诊疗机构的主要工作负荷。目前，癌症登记系统仅能捕获同步性脑转移瘤，而这仅占所有脑转移瘤的一小部分。我们旨在开发并验证一种自然语言处理（NLP）算法，用于从放射学报告中识别脑转移瘤，从而实现对异步性脑转移瘤的可扩展监测。方法：利用加拿大艾伯塔省基于人群的癌症登记数据，我们确定了2012至2019年间诊断、随访至2022年的癌症队列。识别了癌症诊断时及诊断后的所有脑部/头部放射学报告。报告通过多阶段方法进行抽样，并人工标注脑转移瘤的存在情况。我们分别在“所见”和“印象”部分训练了两个Bio_ClinicalBERT模型，并取最大预测概率作为报告级别的预测结果。内部和外部验证使用了来自加拿大艾伯塔省、安大略省和不列颠哥伦比亚省的报告。结果：模型在1，879个样本上进行训练。内部验证中，测试了来自357名患者的1，833份报告。在概率阈值为0.4时，模型的灵敏度为0.888，精确率为0.499。集成模型显著优于单部分模型，后者灵敏度分别仅为0.678（所见）和0.742（印象）。外部验证中，安大略省灵敏度为0.837，不列颠哥伦比亚省为0.726，表明其在不同数据来源间具有稳健性。结论：已开发出一种同时处理“所见”和“印象”部分的基于NLP的流程，并在加拿大三个省份进行了验证。该流程满足癌症登记系统的操作要求，将被纳入艾伯塔省和不列颠哥伦比亚省的监测工作流程，为人群水平的脑转移瘤监测奠定基础。我们的代码公开 available at: https://github.com/valerie-lth/BM-NLP。

papers.title: Network responses to meditation and baseline connectivity correlates of cognitive improvement in schizophrenia
papers.translated_title: 精神分裂症患者对冥想的网络反应及认知改善的基线连接相关性
papers.author: Wang, Q.
papers.summary: Meditation based rehabilitation may improve symptoms and cognition in schizophrenia, but how these responses relate to changes in brain network interactions remains unclear. We conducted a secondary analysis of longitudinal clinical assessments and resting-state functional MRI at baseline, 3 and 8 months in a randomized trial of 64 male inpatients comparing meditation-based rehabilitation with general rehabilitation. Each analysis included all participants with the required measurements: 62 for clinical, 44 for three-visit connectivity and 43 for joint neural clinical models. Symptom treatment effects increased between months 3 and 8, whereas cognitive benefit was clearest at 3 months. In the clinical cross-lagged panel model, early cognitive improvement was associated with cumulative symptom improvement at 8 months (beta = 0.136; nominal P = 0.044); bootstrap intervals included zero for this association and the indirect treatment effect. Intrinsic network properties showed no treatment contrasts surviving multiplicity correction. Spectral dynamic causal modelling and parametric empirical Bayes identified eight treatment-associated connections shared across models with and without head-motion adjustment. Two early effects were consistent across five model specifications, sharing a supramarginal frontal source with sensorimotor and bilateral middle frontal targets. Adding baseline connectivity and early changes in these connections to clinical and motion covariates increased conditional in sample R2 most for 3-month cognitive improvement, by 0.147. Baseline connectivity supplied most of this increment (0.125); its two associations, modelled as common across treatment arms, retained their directions across all participant omissions. Early change associations with clinical outcomes were imprecise. These findings distinguish treatment-responsive network interactions from the baseline connectivity that adds most information about cognitive improvement. They motivate a testable account in which initial sensory attention coordination supports engagement with rehabilitation, while changing practice demands shape network responses.
papers.translated_summary: 基于冥想的康复可能改善精神分裂症患者的症状和认知，但这些反应与脑网络相互作用变化之间的关系仍不清楚。我们在一项随机试验的二次分析中，对64名男性住院患者进行了纵向临床评估和静息态功能MRI分析，时间点包括基线、3个月和8个月，比较基于冥想的康复与一般康复。每项分析均纳入具有所需测量数据的全部参与者：临床分析62人，三次访视连接性分析44人，联合神经-临床模型分析43人。症状治疗效果在3至8个月间增加，而认知获益在3个月时最为明显。在临床交叉滞后面板模型中，早期认知改善与8个月时累积症状改善相关（beta = 0.136；名义P = 0.044）；该关联及间接治疗效应的bootstrap区间均包含零。内在网络属性未显示经多重性校正后仍存活的治疗对比。谱动态因果建模和参数经验贝叶斯识别出八个治疗相关连接，这些连接在有无头动校正的模型中共享。两个早期效应在五种模型设定中一致，共享一个缘上回额叶源，靶向感觉运动区和双侧中额叶。将基线连接性和这些连接的早期变化加入临床及运动协变量后，条件样本内R2增加最多的是3个月认知改善，增量为0.147。基线连接性贡献了该增量的大部分（0.125）；其两个关联被建模为跨治疗组共通，在所有参与者剔除分析中均保持方向不变。早期变化与临床结局的关联不精确。这些发现区分了治疗反应性网络相互作用与基线连接性，后者提供了关于认知改善的大部分信息。它们引出一个可检验的解释：初始感觉注意协调支持康复参与，而不断变化的练习需求塑造网络反应。

papers.title: Multi-agent LLM diagnostic teams improve differential recall on curated cases and reverse on real emergency notes: a label-level reversal without a clinician-judged safety difference
papers.translated_title: 多智能体大语言模型诊断团队在精选病例上提高了鉴别诊断召回率，但在真实急诊记录上出现逆转：一种标签层面的逆转，而临床医生判定的安全性并无差异
papers.author: Feng, J.
papers.summary: Background. Multi-agent large language model (LLM) pipelines are proposed for diagnostic support, but when they help or harm is unknown: evaluations use curated case reports, rarely include budget-matched controls, or isolate perspective independence. Methods. We compared a single direct call (Ax1), five specialist personas voiced within one context (P), and the same five roles run as isolated, mutually blinded agents integrated by a moderator (MDT), with five repeat runs per case, on 87 clinicopathological conference (CPC) cases, 406 MedCaseReasoning cases, 364 emergency-department encounters, and a protocol-frozen 392-vignette replication cohort, scored by an LLM judge validated against blinded clinicians, with a three-physician blinded safety rating of the discordant pairs. Findings. On curated vignettes the moderated team improved the pre-specified recall endpoints, not top-1 accuracy (CPC +5.5, MedCaseReasoning +3.0, replication +3.3 points at top-3; p = 0.0079, 0.0079, 0.0013); a factorial attributed the gain to independent generation plus moderated synthesis, not personas. On 364 real emergency notes (labels: clinicians' working diagnoses, 46% symptom-level), the direction reversed (top-3 -6.4 points, p = 0.0022), widened with objective results, and replicated in a second open-weight family. A five-corpus dose-response is consistent with input curation driving the sign (post hoc; corpora differ in provenance and granularity). A symptom-permissive output contract closed the reversal's breadth end but not its ordering end, and blinded physicians judged neither strategy's errors more dangerous (68% ties; a null powered for large effects only). Interpretation. Multi-agent pipelines are input-conditional: they improve differential-list recall (not top-1 accuracy) on curated inputs and underperform on uncurated emergency text - a label-level reversal without a clinician-judged safety difference. Strategy selection should key on the input and model family, observable before the model runs, as a routing hypothesis; curated-benchmark gains should not be extrapolated to front-line care.
papers.translated_summary: 背景。多智能体大语言模型（LLM）流水线被提出用于诊断支持，但其何时有益或有害尚不清楚：评估使用精选病例报告，很少包含预算匹配的对照，或隔离视角独立性。方法。我们比较了单次直接调用（Ax1）、在单一上下文中表达的五位专家角色（P），以及作为隔离、相互盲视的智能体运行并由主持人整合的相同五个角色（MDT），每例重复运行五次，在87例临床病理讨论会（CPC）病例、406例MedCaseReasoning病例、364例急诊科就诊记录，以及一个方案冻结的392例情景复现队列上进行，由经盲法临床医生验证的LLM评判者评分，并对不一致配对进行三名医生的盲法安全性评级。发现。在精选情景上，主持团队改善了预设的召回终点，而非top-1准确率（CPC +5.5、MedCaseReasoning +3.0、复现 +3.3个百分点，top-3；p = 0.0079、0.0079、0.0013）；析因分析将增益归因于独立生成加主持整合，而非角色设定。在364份真实急诊记录上（标签：临床医生的工作诊断，46%为症状层面），方向逆转（top-3 -6.4个百分点，p = 0.0022），随客观结果而扩大，并在第二个开放权重家族中复现。五语料剂量-反应与输入精选驱动符号一致（事后；语料在来源和粒度上不同）。症状宽松的输出契约缩小了逆转的广度端但未缩小其排序端，盲法医生判定两种策略的错误均不更危险（68%平局；仅对大型效应有检验力的零结果）。解释。多智能体流水线是输入条件性的：它们在精选输入上改善鉴别列表召回（而非top-1准确率），在未精选的急诊文本上表现不佳——这是一种标签层面的逆转，而无临床医生判定的安全性差异。策略选择应基于输入和模型家族，在模型运行前即可观察，作为路由假设；精选基准的增益不应外推到一线照护。

papers.title: MULTIMODAL EEG WORLD MODEL: SELF-SUPERVISED LATENT TRANSITION LEARNING FOR WEARABLE EEG SEIZURE DETECTION
papers.translated_title: 多模态脑电世界模型：面向可穿戴脑电癫痫检测的自监督潜在状态转移动学习
papers.author: Yin, Z.
papers.summary: Existing supervised and self-supervised EEG models mainly learn within-segment discriminative or reconstructive representations, leaving transitions between adjacent EEG segments underexplored. We propose a self-supervised Multimodal EEG World Model for EEG seizure detection that predicts the latent representation of the next EEG segment from the current EEG state, conditioned on synchronized ECG, EMG, and movement signals. A learnable query-based fusion module aggregates the multimodal synchronized signals into a compact physiological condition. Pretraining uses no seizure labels; downstream detection retains only the frozen EEG encoder and a linear probe. On the SeizeIT2 dataset with a strict patient-wise split, the model achieved an AUPRC of 0.3748, ROC-AUC of 0.8025, and balanced accuracy of 0.7308, outperforming official database baselines (SVM with hand-crafted features and ChronoNet), an external baseline (DSAINet), and a foundation model (NeuroLM). Ablations show a 14.4% relative AUPRC gain over a random-initialized encoder, supporting multimodal-conditioned latent transition learning for wearable EEG representation learning.
papers.translated_summary: 现有的监督和自监督EEG模型主要学习片段内的判别性或重建性表征，对相邻EEG片段之间的过渡关注不足。我们提出了一种用于EEG癫痫检测的自监督多模态EEG世界模型，该模型以同步的ECG、EMG和运动信号为条件，从当前EEG状态预测下一个EEG片段的潜在表征。一个基于可学习查询的融合模块将多模态同步信号聚合为紧凑的生理条件。预训练不使用癫痫标签；下游检测仅保留冻结的EEG编码器和线性探针。在采用严格按患者划分的SeizeIT2数据集上，该模型取得了0.3748的AUPRC、0.8025的ROC-AUC和0.7308的平衡准确率，优于官方数据库基线（使用手工特征的SVM和ChronoNet）、外部基线（DSAINet）以及基础模型（NeuroLM）。消融实验表明，相较于随机初始化编码器，AUPRC相对提升14.4%，支持了多模态条件潜在过渡学习用于可穿戴EEG表征学习的有效性。

papers.title: Seeded Probes Do Not Identify a Reviewer's Miss Rate: One-Sided Misclassification in Distribution-Free Risk Control
papers.translated_title: 种子探针无法识别审稿人的漏检率：无分布风险控制中的单侧误分类
papers.author: Kotabhattara, K. C.
papers.summary: Distribution-free risk control certifies that the rate of defects that would change clinical management, among the answers an AI system releases, stays below a stated level, calibrated on cases a human reviewer has checked. The reviewer is an imperfect reference standard whose errors run one way: a missed defect enters calibration as a safe label. This one-sided misclassification lowers the risk on record at every release threshold, so the certificate is anti-conservative by a factor set by the reviewer's miss rate on the system's own defects. We show that seeded probes, which plant known defects and count the catches, do not identify this miss rate. A reviewer's chance of missing a defect depends on how hard that defect is to spot, its detectability. A probe samples defects at detectabilities its designer chose. The system's own defects fall at detectabilities nothing chose, and converting the probe's miss rate into theirs requires the very rate being sought. This holds whenever detectability is not fully captured by an observed score, since a score that captured it would let probes covering its range identify the rate. Cytology field validation builds probe sets whose miss rate is a floor on the true one. Even then the probe bounds the rate from below only, so it can reject a certificate and cannot grant one. The finite-sample label-noise corrections assume noise independent of the case given its label, but a reviewer misses the defects that read as plausible, and the condition they need fails in all four simulated reviewer profiles we examine. Testing that condition on an independent sample takes 185 adjudicated cases for a reviewer missing 85% of defects and 147,938 for one missing 3%. A second reader who adjudicates the cases the careful reviewer passed finds a miss with 95% confidence within 498, so looking for the noise directly costs far less than testing a model of it. In a public corpus of model answers graded by physicians, a physician passed 26.3% of the defects the other graders agreed were there (95% interval 21.6% to 31.7%, resampling whole conversations), on criteria about seeking context and stating uncertainty, and individual rates ran from 8.0% to 54.5%.

papers.title: Association of neurotransmitter-based polygenic scores with antidepressant treatment outcomes in patients with major depressive disorder
papers.translated_title: 基于神经递质的多基因评分与重度抑郁症患者抗抑郁治疗结局的关联
papers.author: Sharew, N. T.
papers.summary: Biologically informed polygenic scores (PGSs) may help interpret genetic associations with treatment outcomes. Here, we computed neurotransmitter-based PGSs (NeuroPGSs) for patients with major depressive disorder (MDD) and assessed their association with SSRI treatment outcomes. By targeting genetic variants involved in key neurotransmission pathways, we developed PGSs for serotonergic (5228), gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA, 4103), dopaminergic (7061), and glutamatergic (5690) variants. We leveraged data from two cohorts of patients who received SSRIs for at least 4 weeks: the International SSRI Pharmacogenomics Consortium (ISPC) and the Pharmacogenomics Research Network Antidepressants Medication Pharmacogenomics Study (PGRN-AMPS). Treatment response was defined as [≥]50% reduction from baseline depression symptoms, measured using 17-item Hamilton Rating Scale for Depression (HRSD-17) in ISPC and 16-item Quick Inventory of Depressive Symptomatology (QIDS-C16) in PGRN-AMPS. Remission was defined as HRSD-17 [≤]7 (ISPC) or QIDS-C16[≤]5 (PGRN-AMPS). The association between each NeuroPGS and antidepressant response or remission was evaluated using logistic regression models, adjusting for age, sex and five genetic principal components, with statistical significance determined at Benjamini Hochberg-adjusted p<0.05. The GABAergic-based PGS was associated with SSRI response (aOR per SD = 1.45, 95%CI: 1.14-1.85). Patients with the highest GABAergic PGS (10th decile) had 2.59-fold higher odds of response (95%CI: 1.46-4.60) compared to those with the lowest decile (1st decile). These exploratory findings support further evaluation of NeuroPGSs; independent replication and assessment of incremental predictive value are needed before clinical application. Keywords: Polygenic score; Neurotransmitters; GABAergic; depression; SSRIs; pharmacogenomics
